title: Pick a brand direction
why: Three directions are built (Daylight, Signal, Seal); the app icon, DESIGN.md and site tokens wait on one.
blocks: Logo files, app icon, DESIGN.md, store listings, every public page
recommend: Daylight: warm, welcoming, matches the sunrise meaning of the name and the not-a-rival tone in PRODUCT.md

title: Choose who owns Emera at the start
why: Grants, donations, the DMCA agent filing and Stripe all need a legal owner.
blocks: DMCA agent name, donations, grant applications, Stripe Connect, hiring
recommend: Techguyver Labs LLC now; join a 501(c)(3) host or file Form 1023 by M2 (about week 13). Ask Software in the Public Interest and one more host whether creator payouts are allowed before applying.

title: Claim @emerasocial on four platforms
why: Free today on TikTok, YouTube and Bluesky; Instagram probably free. Handles get taken.
blocks: Every launch post, press links, the DM campaign, trademark evidence of use
recommend: Claim @emerasocial on TikTok, YouTube, Instagram and Bluesky (emerasocial.bsky.social) in one sitting; also GitHub emera-social. Check X and Threads logged in.

title: Approve emera.social production go-live
why: Production deploy is a stop that needs your yes; staging is up and tested.
blocks: Real sign-in, first creators, the landing page on the real domain, M0 exit test
recommend: Yes after the DMCA agent filing and Resend are done, same day

title: Register the DMCA agent ($6)
why: Without a registered agent we lose safe harbor for user uploads (17 U.S.C. 512(c)(2)).
recommend: File at dmca.copyright.gov under the entity from the ownership choice; use a role address like dmca@emera.social and a real postal address; renew every 3 years; put the same details on emera.social/legal. Confirm the fee on the filing page.

title: Create Resend account, send from emera.social
why: Sign-in codes are only logged today; production refuses to send.
blocks: Real sign-in, invites by email, M0 exit test
recommend: Free tier is 3,000 emails per month, 100 per day; verify the emera.social domain in Cloudflare DNS, then `key set RESEND_API_KEY`. I add the DNS records.

title: Check Canada and EU trademarks
why: US search is clear but Emera Inc. is Canadian and an EU mark may exist (EUTM 014359897).
blocks: Spending on brand and logo, lawyer hour, store listing name
recommend: 10 minutes in a normal browser: search emera at ised-isde.canada.ca/cipo/trademark-search/srch and look up EUTM 014359897 at EUIPO eSearch; paste what you see back to me.

title: Book one lawyer: terms, notices, trademark
why: We send takedowns under penalty of perjury for creators and take their screenshots into a dataset.
blocks: Takedown notice template, report terms, dataset consent, name decision, M1 launch
recommend: One IP lawyer, fixed fee for: notice template, creator authorization, report and dataset terms, a read of the Emera name; budget $1,500 to $3,000 [inferred]. Also ask whether Cloudflare's CSAM tool covers our 2258A duty.

title: Name 20 illustrators you can DM
why: The first creators come from people who know you; 200 cold DMs convert worse.
blocks: M1 (100 creators), the first Taken-down receipts
recommend: Send me a list of 20 illustrators or merch sellers you know or follow, plus any who have complained about stolen art; I draft the DMs, you send them.

title: Post your own profile and 10 works
why: Nobody joins an empty network; yours is the example.
blocks: The public profile demo, press screenshots, invite trust
recommend: Sign up at staging, pick a handle, post 10 pieces of your own work, via the web or app.

title: Apply to Cloudflare for Startups
why: Credits ($10,000 up to $250,000+, sources disagree) cover hosting for a year.
recommend: Apply at cloudflare.com/startups as Techguyver Labs with the Emera repo and landing page; check whether a nonprofit route exists.

title: When does the repo go public?
why: Contributors need it public; a leak scan comes first.
blocks: Contributors, grant applications, press story, M2 exit test
recommend: Public at week 6 (end of Dec 2026), AGPL servers and MIT SDKs, author Techguyver Labs <oss@techguyverlabs.org>, after the leak scan for emails and home paths.

title: Intro to a creator organization
why: A guild or coalition brings hundreds of members and credibility.
recommend: Introduce us to one of: Graphic Artists Guild, Concept Art Association, Professional Photographers of America, or an illustrators' collective you know; offer free takedown help to members.

title: Store listing name and developer account
why: An iOS app named Emera by Emera AI Inc. exists; Android package com.emera.com is unchecked.
blocks: TestFlight and store submission, app naming
recommend: List as Emera Social (bundle id social.emera.app), publish under the LLC's existing Apple account, check com.emera.com on Google Play before the Android build.
